Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around an instance of a binary search specification, with the integer width fixed to 8 bits. It does not define the binary search algorithm itself in this file; instead, it introduces constants for an input sequence and a search key, declares the state variables expected by the instantiated BinSearch10 module, and constrains the constants through ConstInit to arbitrary generated values of the intended types. The file is focused on parameter fixing and symbolic initialization rather than defining actions, temporal behavior, or proofs, and it relies on the imported module instance for the underlying algorithm.
